shortDefinition: Search that finds results based on meaning rather than exact keyword matching.
fullDefinition: Semantic search uses embeddings to find content based on conceptual meaning rather than exact words. A semantic search for 'affordable car' will also return results about 'budget vehicle' and 'cheap automobile' because their meaning-vectors are close. This contrasts with traditional keyword search which would only return results containing the exact words. Semantic search is the foundation of modern AI-powered search tools.
